item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Ukraine is under intensified attack as Russia launched a mass missile strike on Kyiv, causing a fire and killing one person, while Russian strikes also damaged Dutch and Austrian embassies. Kyiv responded by striking the key bridge to Crimea for the third time this week, increasing pressure on the occupied peninsula. In parallel, Trump, Xi and Putin met in Shenzhen, pledging to increase oil supply and discussing Ukraine, and Putin invited European leaders to Moscow for talks on ending the war. Macron urged Ukraine's allies to reopen the NATO membership question, and Kushner said Russia is comfortable with NATO-like security guarantees for Ukraine. Battle-related deaths totaled 75,767 in 2024, according to UCDP.

Israel delayed building contracts for a West Bank settlement after UK sanctions on construction firms and used a video of swimming in Gaza to downplay civilian hardships. The International Court of Justice ruling that Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya is being cited as potentially relevant to Israel's genocide defence. The conflict has caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The Western Equatoria governor barred personal bodyguards at SPLM congresses and the governor of Jonglei reported efforts to end clashes in Bor, Duk and Twic East, while elections were postponed again to February 2027.
